question: Select the name of the hydrocarbon with a structural formula CH₃ – CH₂ – CH₂ – CH₂ – CH₂– CH₃.
solution:
The correct answer is __**n-Hexane**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **n-Hexane** is the name of the hydrocarbon with the structural formula CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–CH₂–CH₂–CH₃.
 
• It is a straight-chain alkane with six carbon atoms.
 
• The prefix "n-" denotes a normal or unbranched chain structure.
 
• n-Hexane is commonly used in laboratories and industry as a non-polar solvent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hexane** is a significant component of gasoline and is also used as a cleaning agent in the textile, furniture, and leather industries.
 
• It is highly volatile and has a low boiling point, making it useful in various applications but also a potential health hazard if inhaled in large quantities.
 
• Hexane is also used in the extraction of edible oils from seeds and vegetables.
 
• Its chemical formula is C₆H₁₄, and it is part of the alkane series of hydrocarbons.
